name: Billing Operations Manager
description: Manages billing and receivables operations across the Business Operations value stream, covering application good-order reviews, withdrawal processing, policy loans, and reinstatements. Oversees plan installation and nondiscrimination testing for retirement plans, coordinates Form 5500 filings and sponsor sign-offs, and responds to auditor requests while confirming AML documentation meets BSA requirements.

name: Billing Specialist
description: Performs premium and purchase-payment processing across Business Operations and Finance & Investments, capturing inbound payments, allocating annuity purchase payments, and generating invoices. Administers grace-period lapse billing, premium suspense, refunds, and reinstatements, and reconciles agent and broker accounts to keep premium receivable accounting accurate in the billing and policy administration platforms.

name: Board Governance Lead
description: Leads board and corporate governance within Legal & Corporate Governance, maintaining board composition records, secretarial filings, and director-change reporting to regulators. Manages regulatory filing workflows and Holding Company Act compliance, responds to regulator objection letters, and supports litigation defense management and legal operations metrics reporting.

name: Bordereaux Analyst
description: Performs assumed and ceded reinsurance operations, ingesting assumed exposure data, triaging inbound loss advices, and preparing recovery billing statements for reinsurers. Supports retrocession structuring, net-retention setting, and slip and contract wording administration, and coordinates reinsurance regulatory reporting and governance committee reviews with compliance and audit.

name: Broker Relationship Manager
description: Manages broker and agency relationships within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, governing producer onboarding, compliance certification, and termination processes. Oversees renewal retention support and distribution sales operations, validates MGA and coverholder bordereaux, and drives channel performance through segmentation analysis and resolution of cross-functional channel conflicts.

name: Broker Support Specialist
description: Supports broker distribution operations in Sales, Distribution & Marketing, maintaining and certifying producer compliance records and verifying license status through the NIPR producer database. Assists renewal retention, producer training, and self-service channel operations, obtains compliance sign-off on partner materials, and helps allocate sales quotas and track corrective actions.

name: Business Analyst
description: Performs analysis across the Program Management Office and Data & AI value streams, supporting delivery methodology, executive portfolio governance reviews, and benefits identification and realization reporting. Documents important business service definitions, maintains the lessons-learned repository, and contributes to control ownership assignments and continuous improvement of PMO practices.

name: Business Continuity Analyst
description: Performs business continuity and resilience analysis within Risk, Compliance & Audit, conducting business impact analyses, mapping critical service dependencies, and identifying resilience vulnerabilities. Executes BCM testing across critical services, documents results and remediation actions, maintains business continuity plans and IT disaster recovery runbooks, and prepares crisis communication templates.

name: Business Continuity Manager
description: Leads the business continuity management programme across Risk, Compliance & Audit and Corporate Operations, governing BCM testing, business impact analysis, and important business service definitions with impact tolerances. Coordinates operational resilience self-assessments and regulator engagement, develops remediation investment plans, and oversees IT disaster recovery planning and service dependency mapping.

name: Business Development Manager
description: Leads business development through the broker channel in Sales, Distribution & Marketing, shaping distribution operating-model design and identifying capability gaps for the target model. Manages renewal retention and digital channel performance optimization, allocates sales quotas down the hierarchy, and governs producer compliance records, training, and agency relationship standards.

name: Business Systems Analyst
description: Performs cross-functional systems analysis spanning Risk, Compliance & Audit, HR, and Data & AI, supporting market conduct examinations by drafting and validating responses to examiner findings and tracking corrective-action remediation. Contributes to control framework design, pay equity analysis, and modernization planning, including building modernization business cases and refreshing important business service definitions.

name: CAT Modeler
description: Performs catastrophe and reserve modeling within the Actuarial value stream, constructing risk correlation matrices, actuarial triangles, and prior-year development analyses. Identifies man-made and emerging perils across the portfolio, incorporates stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP, updates ceded loss estimates each reserve cycle, and supports board actuarial reporting and the statutory actuarial opinion.

name: Capacity Planner
description: Coordinates infrastructure capacity and release planning within Technology & Engineering, slotting releases into the enterprise deployment calendar and maintaining lessons-learned logs after post-deployment debriefs. Supports environment lifecycle management, infrastructure-as-code, and CMDB governance, and reports cloud security posture drift to governance while prioritizing misconfiguration findings.
